q: 141. Weight-batching proceeds on

weighing the contents of each bag
accurately estimating the weight of each material to be used in each batch
the assumption of correct dry weight of each size range of each material and the weight of water

q: 142. Cost-benefit studies are essential to

ascertain the relevant escalation in prices
evaluate the viability and worthwhileness of taking up the project

q: 143. Grader is used mainly for
explain: A grader does finishing, shaping and trimming of surfaces.

explain: A larger standard deviation means a wider spread of possible times, so more uncertainty.

q: 146. Slack is given as the difference between
options: latest allowable time and earliest expected time
latest allowable time and the pessimistic time estimate
earliest expected time and latest allowable time
final event time and initial event time
explain: Slack = TL – TE.

q: 147. Negative slack indicates
explain: Negative slack means the event is behind schedule.

q: 148. For all the events along the critical path, the slack is

q: 149. A dummy activity in a network

does not consume time or resources

q: 151. Which of the following is a dummy activity?
options: Awaiting the arrivals of concrete material
explain: Per the answer key, c. Waiting is not physical work, though in strict theory waiting consumes time and is not a dummy.

q: 152. The construction of residential building are treated as

q: 153. The construction of ……… belongs to industrial construction.

q: 155. The pump suitable for high discharge pressure

q: 156. Screw pumps are used for pumping
explain: Screw pumps handle highly viscous liquids.

q: 157. Which information has least hearing on the selection of the pump?
options: Nature of liquid to be handled
explain: Capacity, liquid nature and suction lift directly govern pump choice. The end use matters least.

q: 158. The Contractor is responsible for
options: procuring material which is not supplied by the owner
organising and planning the work as per drawing
executing the work as per specifications laid down on the contact

q: 159. The resources in a construction project are made up of

construction material such as cement, bricks, steel etc

explain: All of these happen after tendering.

q: 163. For the preparation of a construction schedule, the data required is
explain: A schedule needs the operations, activities and output rates.

q: 164. Military type of organization is known as
explain: Line organization follows a military-style chain of command.

q: 165. In the LIB type of contract management, the acronym stands for
explain: LIB = Limited International Bidding.

q: 166. The pre qualification criteria is approved by

q: 167. Which of the document is prepared and submitted by contractor?

q: 170. For which of the following materials, the output of power shovels for a fixed shovel size will be maximum

q: 172. The authority to conduct the monitoring of public procurement in Nepal lies with
explain: The Public Procurement Monitoring Office (PPMO) monitors public procurement in Nepal.

q: 173. For the ICB procurement method, the period of bidding to contractor must be at least

175. In time-cost optimization of a project, crashing is done
options: on all the activities lying on the critical path
only on activities lying on the original critical path and having flatter cost slopes
on original critical activities and those that become critical at any stage of crashing in the order of ascending cost slope
explain: Crashing starts with the cheapest critical activity, and activities that become critical later are included.

q: 176. Site order book is used for recording
options: indents for materials to be ordered
explain: It records the engineer's instructions to the contractor.

q: 177. Free float for any activity is defined as the difference between
options: its earliest finish time and earliest start time for its successor activity
Its latest start time and earliest start time
its latest finish time and earliest start time for successor activity
its earliest finish time and latest start time for its successor activity
explain: Free float = earliest start of the successor – earliest finish of the activity.

q: 178. Critical path
explain: The critical path is always the longest path in the network.

q: 179. The independent float affects only
explain: Independent float is the slack that affects neither predecessors nor successors, only the activity itself.

q: 180. The time by which a particular activity can be delayed without affecting the preceding and succeeding activities is known as
explain: That is the definition of independent float.

q: 181. The time with which direct cost does not reduce with the increase in time is known
explain: Per the answer key, normal time, beyond which more time gives no further saving in direct cost.

q: 182. Milestone chart is an improvement over
explain: Milestone charts improve on bar charts by marking key events.

q: 183. Clamshell are used to remove loose material from inside

q: 184. Which of the following is not another name of Hoe?

q: 185. Hoe is primarily used to excavate
options: below the natural surface of the ground on which the machine rests
trenches requiring precise control of depth
pits of basements requiring precise control of depth
explain: A hoe digs below its own level, including trenches and basement pits.

q: 186. Idlers are

provides a way for management to require that planning be done on a uniform and logical basis
permits management to foresee quickly the impact of variations from the plan

q: 190. The opening of bidding in the process of procurement is

explain: Per the answer key, international-level EOI and RFP.

explain: Per the answer key, up to 2 crore.

explain: The expected time uses all three estimates.

options: shortest possible time in which an activity can be completed if everything goes exceptionally well
time in which the activity is normally expected to complete under normal contingencis
time in which an activity will take to complete in case of difficulty

q: 196. The time in which an activity will take to complete in case of difficulty, is called
explain: That is the definition of pessimistic time.

options: earliest completion time and latest allowable time
latest allowable time and earliest completion time
earliest completion time and normal expected time
latest allowable time and normal allowable time
explain: Float = latest allowable time – earliest completion time.

q: 198. The amount of time by which the activity completion can be delayed without interfering with the start of succeeding activity, is known as
explain: That is the definition of free float.

comparison of actual process with the scheduled progress

q: 201. The jobs going ahead of schedule are conveniently shown in
explain: Per the answer key, Gantt chart.

explain: Per the answer key, all of the above.

explain: A dragline is rated by its bucket capacity.

q: 205. The total activity slack is equal to
options: late start time - early start time
late finish time - early finish time
latest allowable event occurrence time - early finish time

earliest event occurrence time + early finish time

it represents that a programme falls behind schedule and additional resources are required to complete the project in time
the activity is critical and any delay in its performance will delay the completion of whole project

provides a standard method for communication project plans, schedules time and cost performance

CPM technique is useful to minimise the direct and indirect expenses
critical path of a network represents the minimum time required for completion of project
